newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 18.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:

* On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended off 18.11 points to close at 8,020.77, as investors took profits after the previous day's rally pushed the Dow Jones industrial average above 8,000 points for the first time ever.
* Donor governments and international lending agencies led by Japan and the World Bank pledged in Tokyo on Thursday allocated Indonesia $5.3 billion in aid for the year 1997/98.

* On Wednesday, the Jakarta Composite Index closed 1.29 points, or 0.18 percent higher, at 723.50 points on the back of active buying in secondaries and a sharp rise in price of newly-listed finance firm Maharani, brokers said.
Financial markets were closed on Thursday due to a public holiday.
* On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,477.00/9.00 at 0155 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,472.00/7.00.
* Maharani Intifinance after the multifinance's strong debut on Wednesday.
* Soft drink firm Aqua on market talk of a possible alliance with a food and baverage firm.
* Indocement and Indofood after Indocement said it planned to sell its 50.1 percent stake in noodle maker Indofood.
* Property firm Suryamas Dutamakmur on market talk that the firm was expected to book strong financial performance due to a possible lucrative project.
